subject: Urgent: pallet label mismatch at Port of Oakland — staging impacted
messages:
From: Expo Logistics <expo-logistics@example.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 21:10:00 +0000
Subject: URGENT: discrepancy on pallet labels — staging hold at OAK

Hi Dylan / Tessa,

Quick heads up from the Port of Oakland staging yard: while staging the Redwood Inference shipment for the SF Tech Summit (PO 7881) we discovered that Pallet 3 has labels that don't match the manifest. The manifest references "SF-BOOTH-RED-01" but the pallet shows "SAGE-BOOTH-A-03" which triggered a customs hold for verification.

Current status:
- All other pallets (1,2,4) are staged and cleared for onward movement to the advance warehouse.
- Pallet 3 is held at the terminal pending customs verification.
- We are attaching the manifest we received from the carrier (manifest_20260714.pdf).

Options we see: re-label onsite at a bonded facility, reconsign the pallet to the advance warehouse for inspection, or arrange immediate customs broker intervention. The terminal is not releasing the pallet to outbound truckers until the mismatch is resolved — that creates a splice in the load plan for tomorrow's load-in.

Can you confirm how you want us to proceed? If you approve reconsignment we can move the pallet to the nearest bonded yard and re-label; estimated incremental cost ~ $450 reconsignment + storage. If you want us to escalate to Pacific Customs for expedited verification we'll need written authorization and the broker contact.

Attachments: manifest_20260714.pdf

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Operations Manager, Expo Logistics
expo-logistics@example.com
+1 510-555-0198

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Expo Logistics <expo-logistics@example.com>
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 21:32:00 +0000
Subject: Re: URGENT: discrepancy on pallet labels — staging hold at OAK

Ben — thanks for the quick report. Please do not open or unseal the pallet. A few quick asks before we instruct next steps: 

1) Please send the carrier Bill of Lading and a close-up photo of the mismatched label (pallet_photo_1.jpg).
2) Confirm the container/BOL number and the terminal reference (you mentioned "terminal hold" — which gate/yard ID?).
3) If Pacific Customs is required, please provide the broker case reference so we can sign the authorization.

We are leaning to reconsign to the advance warehouse for inspection and re-labeling if that avoids a customs delay, but I need cost and ETA to get approval from finance. Please include an itemized estimate (reconsignment fee, storage/day, relabeling labor). If the estimate is > $700 I will loop in Marissa for a budget exception.

Marissa — cc'ing you to keep you in the loop in case we need to approve emergency logistics spend against event PO 7881.

Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Field Marketing Logistics Lead | Redwood Inference
(d) 415-555-0124

Updating: BOL number is 78923; terminal yard ID is OAK-T4-17. Pacific Customs (cc'd) has placed an informational hold because the label string differs between shipper manifest and pallet stickers — they are requesting ownership verification before release.

Estimate to reconsign to Oakland Bonded Logistics (nearest bonded yard):
- Reconsignment fee (truck + redirection): $450
- First-day bonded storage: $120
- Relabeling labor (estimate): $80
Total estimated incremental: $650 (taxes/fees not included).

Pacific Customs note: if you prefer broker intervention for verification the broker will need signed authorization and the original shipper documentation. That route may take 6–8 hours to resolve; reconsign to bonded yard will push the pallet out of the terminal same day and allow the advance warehouse to inspect/relabel, but requires your approval for the fees.

If we have approval to proceed with reconsignment we will schedule truck pickup and move Pallet 3 to bonded yard; ETA to advance warehouse after relabel is 06:00 on 7/15 (same-day overnight movement).

Ben Carter
Expo Logistics
